shivering, she nods and reaches out for one. 'Thank... you...'

a bit of colour returns as she eats it, though her eyes are still full of tears. she takes a deep breath, and starts, '...please don't tell anyone else about this. I'm sorry if it's a burden asking you to do this, but...'
"I think we've established that I can keep secrets."
'I know. I just... needed to ask.'

she takes another deep breath, and,
'...my sister. I... don't even remember her name... or anything... I just remember... I wasn't watching. Coyotes attacked. I tried to shoot them... I... missed... horribly...'
'All I know after that... is running... I don't know if I even waited for our parents... I just... ran. Fled. Sold my soul to a ***Thing*** just so I could forget. Funny how that worked out, huh...'

"I see." Pause. "The way I see it, coyotes would've gotten her. You still did what you could in that moment."
Roy shakes his head and says quietly, to himself: "I'll really stick to a bow..."
I'm very on board with heroforge having a rubber duck as an option to have in hand
'...I still f-failed her, though... I ran away... I don't even remember if I stuck around to g-give her a burial...'
'...if I didn't even wait for our parents, she might have been e-eaten anyway...' she clutches her head in her hands.
"This might not be the nicest thing for me to say, and sorry about that, but I don't think the coyotes would've cared to kill her beforehand to spare her the pain."
'...how much do guns h-hurt, though? And t-the pain of... betrayal... s-she was only t-two...'
"I'm no expert on guns, as you could probably gather, but I suppose it'd depend on the gun. How old was she?"
'T-two... years...'
"Right. Not sure how it is with others, but our people, even though we grow kinda quicker than others, aren't really at a point to have a deep understanding of stuff like betrayal and such."
'...I robbed her of that chance... and our parents... what happened to them? I don't... remember...'
she lets out a croaky scream of anguish.
"We can't change the past, but even then. Let's assume you hadn't tried to shoot. What then? Would the coyotes have spared her? Or if you had run right up to them. Would they have spared you both?"
'...I... don't know... I don't know... I don't... know...'
'I remember... just little enough... to where I don't know anything...'
"We don't have coyotes back home, but we have wolves. Wolves wouldn't have done either. You probably have done the best you could have at that moment."
'...but I still... fled. Abandoned her. Maybe if I... had stayed... I could have worked at a temple in return... for her life back...'

"But right now you don't remember if there was any temple or anything like that available. And wild beasts don't really tend to come close to towns unless they really have to. You might have been completely on your own there."
'...I had to try. But I didn't. And now I can't...'
'...what can I... even do for her now? To make up for... everything...'
"I don't know if there's any magic that would help her, but I know of a few things you can do in her name."
'***That I don't remember?***' she bursts out in anger, not at Roy but at herself.
